text:
Leah (CS): Heads-up — Heliosphere renewal next week. They want to shorten term from 12mo to 9mo, add +10 seats, and require split invoices for EU and US entities. They also asked if onboarding credit can be prorated across the new term. Any blockers?
Marco (Sales): Can we hold unit price for 9mo? Customer requests same price. Procurement will need two separate POs.
Leah (CS): Risk: PO turnaround might delay signature. They want enablement within 30 days of sign.
Dan (Legal): Split invoices are fine. I need full legal names, VAT IDs, and exact PO wording. I'll draft a brief amendment covering term change and credit allocation.
Priya (Billing): System can issue two invoices and distribute a one-time credit pro rata. Need vendor codes and billing contacts. EU invoice needs VAT handling — confirm VAT registration.
Marco (Sales): I'll ask customer for POs, vendor codes, and VAT IDs now.
Leah (CS): I'll prepare the onboarding checklist and tentatively book two 90-min sessions.
Dan (Legal): I'll add clause: "Onboarding credit to be applied pro rata across issued invoices for the shortened 9-month term unless otherwise agreed in writing." Will route via DocuSign once names/POs received.
Priya (Billing): Once signed I can issue split invoices and apply pro rata credit. Need PO/vendor codes by EOD Wed to meet billing run.
Leah (CS): Action items: Marco collect POs/vendor codes, Dan draft amendment, Priya prep invoice templates, Leah coordinate onboarding dates. Updating tracker. Thanks all :rocket:
